status: Dated reported claims plus explicit carry-forward estimates; integration with final FCFF still required

other_borrowings.treatment: Deduct carrying value as a small-claim proxy; no independent September fair value verified. Do not label it Trinity debt: Note 11 says Trinity was fully repaid in December 2025.

finance_leases.estimate_basis: Annual total less H1 principal = June total 14.821; less reported June noncurrent gives inferred current 0.353. Assumes no new finance leases, modifications or FX effect. Q2 Note 14 reports only an operating-lease acquisition and no other material portfolio changes. This is an estimate, not a reported current balance.
finance_leases.cutoff_principal_payment_estimate: Use the same 0.149 * 72 / 181 already deducted from cash; reduce the outstanding claim by that amount too.
finance_leases.treatment: Treat finance leases as financing. Deduct estimated remaining total liability. Future FCFF must exclude existing finance lease interest/principal payments while correctly including asset depreciation, capex and replacement needs. Do not deduct both a lease claim and its future debt-service cash flows.

contingent_consideration.treatment: Deduct fair-value claim once, carried forward without a new remeasurement. GEOST cash earn-out and Motiv potential stock earn-out are included. If future stock settlement is modeled through extra shares instead, remove the corresponding claim deduction. Never call the entire amount a cash payable.

accrued_claims_locator: 10-Q page 8; supplemental noncash investing/financing disclosures; six months ended June 30
accrued_claims_assumption: Treat as still unpaid claims in the standalone reference estimate. These supplemental period disclosures are not a verified September payable schedule. Test settlement/status uncertainty and reconcile balance-sheet classification. If payment is deducted from cutoff cash or future FCFF, remove the corresponding bridge deduction. Do not also subtract their aggregate balance-sheet liability bucket.

convertible_notes.fair_value_locator: 10-Q Note 6 page 21; convertible senior notes disclosure
convertible_notes.treatment: Primary if-converted case counts conversion shares and zero note claim. Retained-note diagnostics remove conversion shares and require an explicit economic claim value. Principal-only subtraction is rejected as a current market-value proxy. June fair value is dated; September conversion parity is a diagnostic excluding time value, coupon and settlement effects, not a September note quote.

operating_leases.treatment: Keep operating lease occupancy costs/cash payments in operating forecasts, including renewals. Do not also deduct operating lease liabilities. A capitalized-lease alternative would require coordinated changes to EBIT, reinvestment, WACC and peer definitions.

other_items_for_model_integration.name: Unpaid capex
other_items_for_model_integration.treatment: Model payment in cash capex/asset payable roll-forward once; not automatically additional debt. Do not leave it permanently unpaid in a fixed-liability group.

other_items_for_model_integration.name: Contract loss provision
other_items_for_model_integration.treatment: Operating fulfillment cost and provision unwind; capture in forecast once, not both a bridge deduction and operating cash costs.

other_items_for_model_integration.name: Deferred tax liabilities
other_items_for_model_integration.treatment: Reconcile reversal and cash tax forecasts; not an automatic face-value debt deduction. Do not add deferred tax assets separately if their benefits are already forecast.

other_items_for_model_integration.name: Undrawn Iridium bridge commitment
other_items_for_model_integration.treatment: Commitment is neither current cash nor drawn debt in the standalone case; accrued fees are distinct.

other_items_for_model_integration.name: Capped calls
other_items_for_model_integration.treatment: Approximate maximum aggregate future payout, not fair value or cash. Zero asset credit in the conservative reference bridge; required separate discounted payoff sensitivity and qualification. Do not shrink contractual coverage merely because notes converted.

other_claims_scope: No separate NCI or defined-benefit pension liability identified on reviewed consolidated statements/annual benefits note; do not invent zero-valued audited proof of absence. Normal trade liabilities belong in operating working capital. Unclassified residual liabilities remain an integration review item.
